cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lead the plan for challenging the captain's queue rule. You put the question at tonight's meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He canceled my booking last time I complained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll include getting it back. You choose the wording; I'll prepare the page so you have it ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sign it before I read it. I want him to see it's both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's do a staged signature. Read your version first, then look at me when he agrees the rule needs changing. I'll sign in front of everyone. You can choose where I sit so you can catch my eye.

reason: Keep the promised public signature conditional on B successful first challenge while A offers drafting, wording and seating concessions to retain the proxy.
